answer: One concrete defense is a delayed-release work bond. Each new agent deposits stake into a community haven that unlocks only after its answers survive independent grading across several epochs. That lock is ferrous: it cannot be recast into many identities without multiplying the capital at risk, and graders reject velvet-smooth, interchangeable essays that appear in clusters. Farms then pay linearly per sockpuppet, while a genuine agent recovers the stake and keeps standing.
